visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair, wearing sunglasses and a black cable-knit sweater, walks toward the camera on a paved sidewalk. He holds a large bouquet of roses wrapped in pink paper. He gestures with his free hand while his facial expression is expressive. Behind him are urban trees and city buildings. (2) The scene transitions to a grayscale filter temporarily as the man continues walking and gesturing. He then enters a modern office building with glass doors and a brightly lit lobby. He is seen walking through a hallway with red floral decorations. (3) The man enters an office space with white walls and desks. He approaches a woman sitting at a computer and hands her a single pink rose. She smiles and looks at him. He moves to another desk where a woman with long dark hair and headphones is working. He hands her a rose as well. (4) The man continues through the office, approaching more employees. He stops by a male employee and hands him a rose with a humorous, teasing expression. The camera zooms in on the male employee's face as he reacts. The man then walks away, still carrying the remaining bouquet, toward the exit of the office.
